a.d: In Campina Grande, “São João” is the biggest June party: bonfires, forró music, quadrilha dance, corn dishes and “canjica”. Dress as a country person (“caipira”) with plaid shirts. False friend: “festa junina” means June festival, not a joint party.

s: Caribe hispánico · moderar un debate · referencia: Poços de Caldas

a.d: In Poços de Caldas, Christmas Eve (“Ceia de Natal”) is the big family meal at midnight. Expect turkey (“peru”), rice with raisins and panettone. Say “Feliz Natal!” and open gifts after midnight. False friend: “ceia” means supper, not a “seat”.

a.d: In Piracicaba, sharing chores at home is common. Verbs: lavar (wash), varrer (sweep), passar roupa (iron), arrumar (tidy), cozinhar (cook). Ask “Quem faz o quê?”. False friend: “arrumar” means to tidy up or arrange (not “arrive”).
